in_marathi.name: Nagendar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the serpents
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nagendar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nagendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'naga' meaning serpent and 'andra' meaning man. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Naga, the king of serpents. Nagendra is believed to have the power to protect against venomous snakes and to bestow the blessings of good health and prosperity.
